set.body:
Outcome

Adapt current PatternMatrix and PatternOperator kernels to one Multivar-backed scientific evidence representation.

Acceptance

- Dense and matrix-free sources expose the same sample and neural axes.
- Named row-restriction and neural-measurement composition hide primal/dual implementation detail.
- Dense materialization is explicit, policy-controlled, and receipted.
- Adjoint, restriction, reordering, and stacking laws pass on JVM and Scala.js.
- No MVPA-specific unsafe opening is added to Multivar.
set.title: P1.4: represent dense and operator evidence through Multivar Table
